[[Cold Storage]] }} '''Angry Boy''' (Japanese: '''VSオーベム''' ''VS {{tt|Ohbem|Beheeyem}}''), titled '''VS Beheeyem''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 535th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 11th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is subtitled '''Beheeyem''' (Japanese: '''アングリー・ボーイ''' ''Angry Boy'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Angry Boy''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Hugh]] finds that [[Hugh's sister|his sister]] managed to sneak onto [[Pop Roxie]]'s boat. * [[Leo]] befriends Hugh's sister and promises to help Hugh keep her out of sight from everyone else. * After arriving at [[Castelia City]], [[Roxie]] discovers an injured man that was attacked by a group of villains who "liberated" his {{p|Karrablast}}. * {{adv|Blake}}, {{adv|Whitley}}, [[Hugh]], and Roxie travel to the [[Castelia Sewers]], where they find the culprits were [[Team Plasma]], including [[Bronius]] and [[Ryoku]]. * Hugh attacks the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s, but is swarmed by their Pokémon, forcing the group to scatter. * {{adv|Looker}} contacts Hugh via his {{TP|Looker|Croagunk}}, but Hugh mistakenly believes that Croagunk is the one who is talking. * At the [[Cold Storage]], [[Colress]] confronts [[Zinzolin]] about information about {{p|Kyurem}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blake}} * {{adv|Whitley}} * {{adv|Cheren}} * [[Roxie]] * [[Colress]] * [[Bronius]] * [[Ryoku]] * [[Zinzolin]] * [[Hugh]] * [[Leo]] * {{adv|Yuki}} * {{adv|Maya}} * {{adv|Yuko}} * [[Hugh's sister]] * [[Pop Roxie]] * {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s * Students ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Dewott}} ({{OP|Blake|Dewott}}) * {{p|Foongus}} ([[Foongy]];
